accuracy_equivalence.confidence_interval: paired Student-t 90% CI for TOST and 95% CI for estimation
accuracy_equivalence.margin_rationale: Protein targets are standardized from development data; 0.01 MSE is one percent of one standardized target-variance unit.
accuracy_equivalence.success_rule: the complete 20-pair 90% CI lies strictly inside [-0.01, +0.01]

analysis.no_optional_stopping: The strict aggregate refuses missing, duplicate, extra, or non-predeclared seeds and is run only after all 20 pairs for both confirmatory estimands exist.

throughput.secondary_contrast: geometric mean of paired completed-batch ratios, with a t interval on log ratios

normalization.features: per-feature min/range fitted only on the training partition available to that stage
normalization.targets: mean/population-standard-deviation fitted only on the training partition available to that stage

A_fixed_epoch_accuracy_equivalence.pairing: Within each seed, both methods clone one shared initialization and consume byte-identical precomputed minibatch permutations.
A_fixed_epoch_accuracy_equivalence.selection: No checkpoint selection; use the state after exactly ten epochs of full-size drop-last minibatches.

B_time_budget_throughput.budget_rule: median over the five pilot seeds of (Ours ten-epoch pilot training seconds / Ours completed pilot batches), multiplied by the number of batches in ten full-development epochs
B_time_budget_throughput.budget_scope: application training loop: batch materialization, forward/backward, chart operations, preconditioning, optimizer update, refreshes, and periodic reset
B_time_budget_throughput.outcome: reported counters from the last completed batch whose cumulative measured training-loop time is at or below the frozen budget; exactly one subsequent crossing batch is timed but excluded, and no selected model state or accuracy is materialized

implementation.candidate_contract: The optimized path is invoked only for the explicit positive same-vector update G+=G+aa^T and M+=M+aa^T; all chart refreshes use the common fresh factorization path.
implementation.exact_arithmetic_identity: Both methods update the same G and M. Ours uses the exact rank-one recurrence and v_w=v_z because w=z=a; Refact recomputes Cholesky and whitening from the same matrices.
implementation.ours: allocation-free positive same-vector extension with caller-owned ping-pong Aw buffer, vz output, and 4r workspace
implementation.refact: fresh Cholesky plus two triangular solves and full re-whitening after each non-refresh update

method_order.balance: Even task IDs run ours then refact; odd task IDs run refact then ours.
method_order.concurrency: The two methods in a pair run sequentially, never concurrently.

pilot.allowed_outcomes: training MSE and one inner-validation MSE evaluation per method
pilot.purpose: training-only implementation validation and time-budget calibration
pilot.test_access_rule: The source .mat must be parsed to access any row, but fixed test rows may not be indexed into feature/label tensors and no test prediction or metric may be computed.

provenance.campaign_tag_rule: Any code, binary, protocol, data, hyperparameter, seed, resource, or analysis change after a pilot artifact exists requires a new campaign tag.
provenance.historical_split_disclosure: Completed seed-42 E2 outcomes were viewed before this preregistration. Version 2 therefore uses a new split seed derived mechanically from the frozen campaign string, without inspecting any v2 held-out outcome.
provenance.manual_gate_rule: Only the five pilot pairs are submitted initially. Confirmation requires a write-once gate containing exact pilot and budget hashes plus the frozen manual attestation.
provenance.execution_rule: Run from a detached immutable commit; every artifact must match the lock manifest, requested commit, candidate binary, data hash, and runtime contract.
provenance.write_semantics: atomic write-once; an existing destination is an error

resources.affinity: exactly ten distinct physical cores on one socket, one hardware thread per core
resources.preflight: before any Protein access, verify target-node AVX-512 flags, prove zmm instructions occur in candidate-core symbol regions, and compare against fresh factorization at rank 17 plus 64 cumulative rank-1024 positive same-vector updates with the production reset after update 50
resources.warmup: two untimed training-only forced-non-refresh steps per method, with both orders represented, on disposable state clones; no warmup state or outcome enters either estimand

task_mapping.accuracy-pair: array task i in [0,19] maps only to accuracy_confirmation[i]
task_mapping.pilot-pair: array task i in [0,4] maps only to pilot[i]
task_mapping.throughput-pair: array task i in [0,19] maps only to throughput_confirmation[i]
